evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies orphan handling in net_processing.cpp and txdownloadman_impl.cpp.
rationale: Fixes an orphan handling bug where non-peer mempool admissions trigger an Assume(false) assertion in debug builds. The PR description notes that 'an orphan that enters the mempool other than through peer relay (e.g. by RPC) stays in the orphanage, so Find1P1CPackage can pick it as the child of a reconsiderable parent, and package evaluation then reports it as MEMPOOL_ENTRY, which hits Assume(false).'
